svg.aria-label: Cactus: automation foundation models for tiny devices
svg.text: Automation Foundation Models For Tiny Devices

g.text: 2-bit, 8-29MB, runs locally, up to 4k tokens/sec decode speed
On-device AI today is built for computers and humanoids.
Most edge devices are tiny: phones, wearables, smart home
and small robots, and we are racing to own that market.
Needle is the foundation model for that hardware: no GPU, no NPU,
a few dozen MB of RAM, and no network in the loop.
phones, wearables, smart home devices and micro-IoT
One set of weights, every depth from 2 to 20 layers a model of its own.
beats models 10x its size on mobile tool calls
structured extraction and text embedding, on the device
2-bit CQ weights, 8-29 MB, a sub-1 MB engine
up to 4k tokens/s decode on a Raspberry Pi 5
blocks 0 and 19 always kept, the rest added by bisection;
fine-tuned, 4 layers already pass DeepSeek V4 Flash on DroidCall
